title: 第19章 修炼塔榜首第20章 五彩吞天蟒
content_zh:
天才修炼塔内。
林炎眼中闪烁睿智的光泽：“果然！天才修炼塔考验的是一个人的战斗意识和眼界！”
“如果还像是之前那般依靠蛮力，我想要打败第五层的守护兽，最起码得动用七成的实力，而且还需要消耗很多时间。可我专门攻击对手的破绽，只用了四成的实力，就轻易将其秒杀！”
“这个方法，还可以用在平常的战斗中！”
这一刻林炎的战斗意识进一步提升，原本的他只擅长依靠蛮力，而从来没有认真思考过对力量的运用。
但经过天才修炼塔的磨炼，他发现自己对战斗的思考和理解已经发生了质变。
第六层。
难度达到了极点，居然是天级妖兽--狂龙蟒！
天级妖兽，意味着这头妖兽血脉大成之后，媲美天玄境强者！
当然，修炼塔幻化的妖兽虚影只是幼年期。
不然的话就算是长老来了也得死。
但哪怕只是幼年期，也无比可怕，毕竟天级妖兽的防御、速度、力量都达到了同阶顶点。
吼！
那金灿灿的大蟒蛇咆哮着，好似一尊天龙降世，气吞山河，尾巴一扫之下，天崩地裂。
“狂龙蟒，蕴含龙属性血脉的妖兽，虽然这头狂龙蟒只是气海一重，可它的身体强度只怕气海六重都要汗颜失色！”
“这是一种身体防御近乎无解的存在，不过一般注重身体防御的妖兽，精神力都会格外薄弱，也就是所谓的四肢发达头脑简单。”
林炎发现，当自己改变思想之后，看东西的角度和思考模式都不一样了，那种改变让他无比的兴奋。
没有用血龙拳印，林炎一上来，就动用精神力跟狂龙蟒交战。
吼！
正如林炎所预料的那般，狂龙蟒肉身防御无敌，可精神力却很脆弱，大乘中期的精神力扫荡了几下，那狂龙蟒就被打的口吐白沫，眼神涣散，奄奄一息。

最终，林炎施展灵符印记，一击就结束了狂龙蟒的生命。
“以我现在的实力和眼界，就算是第七层也可以去闯，闯过第七层就可以晋升精英弟子，不过那样的话会太张扬，会让那些敌人坐立难安，报复会无比的疯狂。”
林炎放弃了去闯第七层，除非等他的真实战力达到精英弟子水平，不然的话他不想给自己树靶子。
要知道天才修炼塔比的是眼界和意识，而守护兽都是根据闯关者实力幻化，而真正的优秀弟子，随便一个都是气海六重以上。
顶尖优秀弟子，甚至能达到气海九重。
更别说精英弟子了，那都是灵海境的修为，和外山长老属于同一个大境界，他现在成为精英弟子，只会给自己招惹来无尽的麻烦。
“他出来了！”
外界，随着林炎现身，原本躁动的氛围一下子安静下来，无数道目光都朝着林炎投射而来。
“怎么回事？”
被这么多人盯着，林炎有些不安。
难不成是自己成绩太差了？
不应该吧？
这时候守塔执事走上前来，一脸恭敬的道：
content_en:
Inside the genius training tower.
Lin Yan's eyes shone with wisdom: "Sure enough! The Genius Training Tower tests a person's fighting consciousness and vision!"
"If I still rely on brute force as before, if I want to defeat the guardian beast on the fifth floor, I will have to use at least 70% of my strength, and it will also take a lot of time. But I specialize in attacking the opponent's flaws, and I only use 40% of my strength to easily kill him instantly!"
"This method can also be used in ordinary battles!"
At this moment, Lin Yan's fighting consciousness further improved. Originally, he was only good at relying on brute force, but never seriously thought about the use of power.
But after being tempered in the Genius Training Tower, he found that his thinking and understanding of combat had undergone qualitative changes.
The sixth floor.
The difficulty reached the extreme, and it turned out to be a heaven-level monster - the Crazy Dragon Python!
A heaven-level monster means that after its bloodline is fully matured, it will be comparable to a strong person in the Tianxuan Realm!
Of course, the phantom of the monster transformed by the training tower is only in its infancy.
Otherwise, even if the elder comes, he will die.
But even if it is only in its infancy, it is still extremely terrifying. After all, the defense, speed, and strength of the heaven-level monster have all reached the peak of the same level.
roar!
The golden python roared, like a heavenly dragon descending into the world, swallowing mountains and rivers with its anger, and with a sweep of its tail, the sky collapsed and the earth shattered.
"The Crazy Dragon Python is a demonic beast with dragon-attribute blood. Although this Crazy Dragon Python is only at the first level of the Qi Sea, its physical strength would put even the sixth level of the Qi Sea to shame!"
"This is a kind of existence whose physical defense is almost invincible. However, monsters that generally focus on physical defense will have extremely weak mental power, which is the so-called simple mind with well-developed limbs."
Lin Yan found that after he changed his mind, his perspective and way of thinking were different. That change made him extremely excited.
Instead of using the Blood Dragon Fist Seal, Lin Yan used his mental power to fight the mad dragon and python as soon as he came up.
roar!
Just as Lin Yan expected, the Crazy Dragon Python's physical defense was invincible, but its mental power was very fragile. After being swept away by the spiritual power of the middle stage of the Mahayana, the Crazy Dragon Python was beaten until it was foaming at the mouth, its eyes were blurred, and it was dying.
In the end, Lin Yan used the talisman mark and ended the life of the mad dragon python with one blow.
"With my current strength and vision, I can break through even the seventh level. If I pass the seventh level, I can be promoted to an elite disciple. However, that would be too public and would make the enemies uneasy, and the revenge would be extremely crazy."
Lin Yan gave up trying to reach the seventh level. Unless his true combat power reached the level of an elite disciple, he didn't want to create a target for himself.
You must know that what a genius cultivates is vision and consciousness, and the guardian beasts are transformed according to the strength of the challenger, and any truly outstanding disciple is at the sixth level of Qi Sea or above.
Top outstanding disciples can even reach the ninth level of Qi Sea.
Not to mention the elite disciples, who are all at the Linghai realm and belong to the same realm as the elders from outside the mountains. Now that he has become an elite disciple, he will only cause endless trouble for himself.
"He's out!"
Outside, as Lin Yan appeared, the originally restless atmosphere suddenly calmed down, and countless eyes were directed towards Lin Yan.
"What's going on?"
Lin Yan was a little uneasy being stared at by so many people.
Could it be that my grades were too poor?
Shouldn't it?
At this time, the deacon guarding the tower came forward and said respectfully:
